matrixRows: OPEN with empty items, EMPTY with items, or any extra stop-decision field
decimal offset beyond the signed 64-bit range
intent: CF-V0-004 admits exactly two state/items combinations and gives V0 NO stop-decision field. CF-V0-019 requires every offset to be a decimal string that fits a signed 64-bit integer, rejecting a longer digit run rather than wrapping it. CF-V0-022 routes a Frontier document shape, codec, state, order or ID mismatch to noncanonical-frontier. These are fail-closed refusals, not emitted documents.

cases.note: A candidate document declaring OPEN with items: [].
assertions: CF-V0-004: OPEN requires at least one item; the pair is not a valid combination.
CF-V0-022: the code is noncanonical-frontier with exit 2 and NO stdout — never a document emitted with a warning.

cases.note: A candidate document declaring EMPTY with a non-empty items array.
A candidate document carrying an additional top-level stop-decision field.
assertions: CF-V0-004: V0 has no stop-decision field or hook authority.
CF-V0-018: the top-level keys are EXACTLY frontierState, id, inputs, items, profile, scope, universeId; an extra key is a closed-shape violation.
CF-V0-027: V0 MUST NOT advertise a completed Stop hook.

cases.note: A candidate document carrying READY / NEEDS_WIDENING / OUT_OF_SCOPE.
assertions: CF-V0-005: READY, NEEDS_WIDENING and OUT_OF_SCOPE are retrieval-packet terms and MUST NOT appear in the frontier wire.

cases.note: A candidate document whose intentSpan.start digit run no longer fits a signed 64-bit integer.
assertions: CF-V0-019: every offset is a base-10 string with no sign or leading zero whose value fits a signed 64-bit integer; a verifier rejects a longer digit run rather than wrapping it onto a bound value.
